notes.title: Team Bushside - Development Update
notes.notes: [h2]Hey Rangers,[/h2][p][/p][p]I've seen a lot of the recent reviews and I know that a fair amount of you guys are experiencing lots of bugs and glitches, poor optimization and a generally unfavourable experience with Chapter 1. Just so that I don't keep you guys out of the loop, I'd like to explain a bit of what's going on with the game currently![/p][p][/p][p]We previously announced that Chapter 2: Lonely Ruins began development, and while that still holds true, it admittedly hasn't been our main focus. We've been prioritising development of our so-called "Overhaul" for Chapter 1. The currently public iteration of Chapter 1 was developed purely by me, Daniella Garner, as a solo developer. A lot of the game was rushed in an effort to actually finish and release it, so a lot of gameplay aspects weren't fully considered when developing it. This is most noticeable in the main gameplay loop for "The Ranger Conduit".[/p][p][/p][p]As part of our overhaul for the first chapter, we've been completely reworking the game from the ground up. Lots of new gameplay mechanics that weren't seen in the original version, massive graphical and stylistic improvements, audio design improvements and of course, significant changes to our way of storytelling. I feel that all of this is massively required in order for the game to be the best it can be, and I'm sure all of you feel the same way.[/p][p][/p][p]We're also partnering with a company to release the game on consoles too, so if you've wanted to play the game but don't have a PC, keep an eye out on our socials as we update everyone on the overhaul! We really want this game to be the best it can be, and we're doing everything we can to ensure that it ends up to ours, and your expectation. We're all very passionate about this game, and I know that a lot of you have found some form of passion for the game too, so we're very adamant on fixing the first chapter and making it an experience that all of you can truly enjoy![/p][p][/p][p]That's it for this development update, I may do more of these, may not, we'll see! I just wanted to let you all know what's been going on behind the scenes... I appreciate you guys for sticking with us through this journey, even if you didn't like Chapter 1.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p][p][b][i]Daniella Garner (Creator and Game Director at Team Bushside)[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Chapter 2: Lonely Ruins - Teaser Trailer
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi Rangers!![/h1]

Exciting news today, eh? Chapter 2 got it's first trailer!!

[previewyoutube=DbAhi9dToJE;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]What happened at the Bushside Rangers Nature Park? You came for answers, but got yourself into a situation of life or death.[/i]

Further into the desolate park, you take control of Vera, a young girl who's found herself trapped with blood-thirsty mascots and survivors of the park's closure. After being thrown into situation after situation, you end up equipping yourself with a trusty wrench and head lamp, and now you have a new goal: Survive at all costs.

Will you stealth your way to the end, or will you rip and tear at your enemies? The choice is yours, but one thing remains certain: [b]You are not alone.[/b]

Alongside Chapter 2, The Desolate Land (Chapter 1) will be getting an overhaul too! It should fix many issues you guys have with the game, so stay tuned!

See y'all Q1 2026!
- Daniella Garner

notes.title: Chapter 2 Announcement + Patch 3 (v1.0.3)
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Rangers![/h2]

Got an important announcement for y'all...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101622/afe2408e2cce7f1c11e40ce2ee1d985631e08980.png[/img]
You heard it here folks!
[h1][b]Chapter 2: Lonely Ruins[/b] is officially now in development![/h1]

I'm so glad y'all enjoyed Chapter 1, and I'm ESPECIALLY excited for you guys to experience Chapter 2! If you thought Chapter 1 was scary, things are only gonna get worse from here on out...

Now! Regarding what I was wanting to implement into Chapter 1 prior to Chapter 2's release, all of the major stuff is being delayed until Chapter 2's release.

BUT in the meantime, I feel that Chapter 1 is now in a fairly decent place thanks to this new update!

Here are the patch notes for those interested:

[h2]Systematic[/h2]
[list]
[*]Main menu UI has been improved, and is now less cluttered.
[*]Save file system has been revamped massively.
[*]Added an FPS cap to the Display settings.
[*]Added an FPS counter toggle to the Display settings.
[/list]
[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed the loading screen not displaying correctly when starting a new save after playing in another save file.
[*]Changed font for most text to make it more readable, and visually better at different resolutions.
[*]Did some minor adjustments to the Skytram Entrance checkpoint (after putting the battery in).
[*]Chapter Select now doesn't affect save files, will require you to play through each chapter in a main save file before unlocking them in Chapter Select (with the exception of Chapter 1).
[*]Getting out of a hiding spot whilst crouched or running will set the correct player speed.
[*]The save system now saves the amount of time you've spent in your selected save file!
[*]Improved the Sky Tram Entrance trigger for the battery collection sequence.
[*]Adjusted some textures, certain areas should look a bit better now.
[/list]

I know it's not the biggest update, but it does improve some important stuff that will improve the general player experience! and until next time!!

Thank you!
- Daniella Garner

notes.title: Patch 2 - v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey Rangers, here's the patch notes for v1.0.2!

[list]
[*]Cutscenes and cinematic sequences are now skippable by holding down E (or X if you're using an Xbox controller)!!
[*]Fixed an issue with the intro cutscene where the camera would lag behind if you went to the gate too quickly.
[*]Fixed the checkpoint in the final chase to make sure nobody accidentally spawns below the map.
[*]Fixed an issue with video files not playing properly. (Some may still display as a white screen, please bear with me while I try to fix this in a future update.)
[*]Chester is now a bit more balanced in the final chase sequence (a bit slower, and also spawns further behind when Simon breaks the glass.)
[*]Moved the checkpoint in Ranger Gifts to be a bit further away from any squeaky toys, as to allow a safe spot for the player when loading the save.
[*]Squeaky toys in Ranger Gifts can now be squeaked even if Chester is going towards the location of a previous squeaky toy.
[*]Chester's AI should be a bit less scuffed now. [In other words, he can no longer teleport out of the map...]
[*]Jumpscare-related audio should properly be able to be adjusted in settings.
[*]The second-final cutscene now has audio that wasn't present before.
[*]Fixed the interact screen visual not appearing after doing a Ranger Conduit or using the Speaker System.
[*]Fixed the hint visuals not appearing by default (if you haven't changed them in the Gameplay settings)
[*]Readjusted the height of the Speaker System to make Vera less short when looking at it.
[*]Made it more clear what you're supposed to do in the final chase (the locked door).
[*]I kinda forgot that Chester was a Chimpanzee when developing the game. Removed his tail.
[*]Added the input icon for interacting when looking at an interactable.
[*]Sensitivity is able to be reduced a bit lower now.
[*]The bike bell in the intro is now ringable. :)
[/list]

Next two updates will probably be smaller bug fixes and QoL updates, just to help with the wait for the next major update that'll re-do the entire audio system, subtitle system and all of the in-game animations! I'm really hoping with that update, I can get some subtitle translations done too, but we'll see! (It'll happen eventually though 100%!!)

Thank you for your continued patience, and I hope you enjoy the new patch!
- Daniella Garner

notes.title: Patch 1 - v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey Rangers, here's the patch notes for v1.0.1!

[list]
[*]Simon's AI has been reworked, he now patrols around the Simon Sector without being able to camp at any given Ranger Conduit.
[*]Chester's AI has been reworked as well, hopefully he's less frustrating to deal with.
[*]Jumpscare Alerts have been changed, they should be a little more jarring but fair.
[*]Screen visuals for being pursued by an enemy has been adjusted.
[*]Using a Ranger Conduit for the first time has a pop-up tutorial explaining how to use it.
[*]Failing the Ranger Conduit now alerts Simon or Chester to your whereabouts.
[*]The door breaking sequence in the final chase has been overhauled.
[*]Fixed collision of rubble in the Simon glass breaking hallway, so you can't skip that cutscene.
[*]Simon and Chesters' lines are less common and repeated now.
[*]Tape recorder collectable in the final chase now stops when you initiate the ending cutscene.
[*]The tape recorder dialogue now has English subtitles.
[*]Pausing when hiding doesn't make you stuck anymore.
[*]Invisible walls in the Simon Sector aren't as limiting when powering the Ranger Conduits.
[*]Fixed the audio timing for Laurel's Ranger Radio training video.
[*]Fixed the pause menu requiring you to press escape again to resume.
[*]Collectables are a bit more visible now.
[*]Fixed some minor visual issues.
[*]Vera is now a bit shorter.
[/list]

I'll be doing more updates asap, please keep the bug reports coming!

Thank you!
- Daniella Garner

notes.title: Post-Launch Message
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Rangers![/h2]

It's been a very exciting day, huh? Can't believe the park's open once again!!

Nah but in all seriousness, a LOT of people have been checking out the game and I'm very honoured!! Y'all seem to be enjoying what I've made, and I'm genuinely so glad to hear that!! But of course... just like any other game release, there's issues...

Which is why I ask YOU to help me!

I'm a single developer (@daniellagdev on Twitter) and this is my first major, MAJOR game so I really do want it to be as polished and fun as I can possibly make it! The only other person helping me with the game is Squeaks D'Corgeh (Known for popular indie hit [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2160220/Shipwrecked_64/]Shipwrecked 64[/url]) who's assisted me with technical aspects, as well as helping me out with animations for future updates!!

And so, where you come in, is reporting bugs and providing feedback to me! I'll be taking ALL of your feedback into consideration, and it'll go towards improving the game as a whole! This is only a fifth of the full game, but I want it to be the best first fifth it can be, and to do that I need y'all to help me!

So starting off, the first update to the game will be the Day One patch, v1.0.1, which will be fixing a fair amount of issues that people have been having with things like the AI, Gameplay Mechanics, things not being explained well enough, etc. and that should already serve as a major stepping stone for what's to come!! All of the issues that will be fixed in this update are issues that you guys have documented, whether it be in the steam reviews or YouTube videos!

After the Day One patch, I'll be continuing to work on the game until it's in a state that I'm happy with, and then we'll begin work on Chapter 2! I estimate that to be around v1.1.0 or so, we'll see what happens though!

But yeah, that's all I wanted to say! I'm working on a Discord server for the game at the moment, so once that's finished, I'll put it here and I'll include it in the game too, so feel free to join that once it's done so that we have a more centralized community to assist with reporting bugs!

I'll be off now, have a wonderful Bushside day!!
[i]- Daniella Garner[/i]
